Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ atorofoɔ
1 # 2 Ti 3.1; 2 Pe 3.3; Yuda 18; 1 Yoh 2.18 Na honhom no ka no pefee sɛ nna a ɛdi akyire no mu, ebinom bɛfam nnaadaa ahonhom ne ahonhommɔne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho atwe wɔn ho afiri gyidie no ho, 2atorofoɔ nkontompo nti. Wɔn na wɔn ahonim awuo. 3#Gye 9.3; 1 Ko 10.30-31 Wɔsi awadeɛ ho kwan ka sɛ, wɔntua wɔn ho nnuane a Onyankopɔn bɔɔ sɛ agyidifoɔ ne wɔn a wɔahunu nokorɛ mfa aseda nni bie no. 4#Gye 1.31; Aso 10.15 Na Nyankopɔn abɔdeɛ nyinaa yɛ, na sɛ yɛde aseda gye a, ɛnneɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛkyiri biribiara; 5ɛfiri sɛ wɔde Nyankopɔn asɛm ne mpaebɔ na ɛte ho.
6Sɛ wode yeinom kyerɛ anuanom a, wobɛyɛ Kristo Yesu somfo pa a wɔde gyidie ne nkyerɛkyerɛ pa a wodii akyire no nsɛm ayɛne no.
Abrabɔ pa ho afotuo
7 # 1 Ti 1.4; 6.20; 2 Ti 2.16; 2.23; Tito 1.14; 3.9 Na mmerewa anansesɛm ahuhuo no deɛ, gu, na bɔ onyamesom pa ho mmɔden; 8#1 Ti 6.6 na honam mu mmɔdemmɔ ho mfasoɔ sua, na onyamesom pa ho wɔ mfasoɔ, ade nyinaa mu, na ɛwɔ nkwa a ɛwɔ hɔ yi ne deɛ ɛrebɛba no ho bɔhyɛ. 9#1 Ti 1.15 Ɛyɛ nokwasɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔgye koraa. 10#1 Ti 2.3-4 Yei nti na yɛyɛ adwuma brɛ na yɛpere, ɛfiri sɛ yɛde yɛn ani ato Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ a ɔyɛ nnipa nyinaa, ne titire no agyidifoɔ, Agyenkwa no so. 11Yeinom na tu ho fo dendeenden na kyerɛkyerɛ!
Ɔbra pa ne mmɔdemmɔ
12 # Tito 2.15 Mma obi mmmu wo aberanteɛ a woyɛ no animtiaa, na mmom yɛ agyidifoɔ nhwɛsoɔ ɔkasa mu, abrabɔ mu, ɔdɔ mu, gyidie mu, ahoteɛ mu. 13Bata akenkan, afotuo ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho kɔsi sɛ mɛba. 14#1 Ti 5.22; Aso 6.6; 8.17 Mma wo mu adom akyɛdeɛ a wɔnam nkɔmhyɛ ne mpanimfoɔ nsa a wɔde guu wo soɔ no so de maa woɔ no nnna hɔ kwa. 15Yeinom ho na bɔ mmɔden, yeinom mu na keka wo ho, na wo nkɔsoɔ ada adi ade nyinaa mu. 16#Rom 11.14 Ma w’ani mmra wo ho ne nkyerɛkyerɛ no so na tena mu, ɛfiri sɛ woyɛ saa a, wobɛgye wo ho ne w’atiefoɔ nkwa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na honhom no ka no pefee sɛ nna a ɛdi akyire no mu, ebinom bɛfam nnaadaa ahonhom ne ahonhommɔne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho atwe wɔn ho afiri gyidie no ho, atorofoɔ nkontompo nti. Wɔn na wɔn ahonim awuo. Wɔsi awadeɛ ho kwan ka sɛ, wɔntua wɔn ho nnuane a Onyankopɔn bɔɔ sɛ agyidifoɔ ne wɔn a wɔahunu nokorɛ mfa aseda nni bie no. Na Nyankopɔn abɔdeɛ nyinaa yɛ, na sɛ yɛde aseda gye a, ɛnneɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛkyiri biribiara; ɛfiri sɛ wɔde Nyankopɔn asɛm ne mpaebɔ na ɛte ho.
Sɛ wode yeinom kyerɛ anuanom a, wobɛyɛ Kristo Yesu somfo pa a wɔde gyidie ne nkyerɛkyerɛ pa a wodii akyire no nsɛm ayɛne no.

Na mmerewa anansesɛm ahuhuo no deɛ, gu, na bɔ onyamesom pa ho mmɔden; na honam mu mmɔdemmɔ ho mfasoɔ sua, na onyamesom pa ho wɔ mfasoɔ, ade nyinaa mu, na ɛwɔ nkwa a ɛwɔ hɔ yi ne deɛ ɛrebɛba no ho bɔhyɛ. Ɛyɛ nokwasɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔgye koraa. Yei nti na yɛyɛ adwuma brɛ na yɛpere, ɛfiri sɛ yɛde yɛn ani ato Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ a ɔyɛ nnipa nyinaa, ne titire no agyidifoɔ, Agyenkwa no so. Yeinom na tu ho fo dendeenden na kyerɛkyerɛ!

Mma obi mmmu wo aberanteɛ a woyɛ no animtiaa, na mmom yɛ agyidifoɔ nhwɛsoɔ ɔkasa mu, abrabɔ mu, ɔdɔ mu, gyidie mu, ahoteɛ mu. Bata akenkan, afotuo ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho kɔsi sɛ mɛba. Mma wo mu adom akyɛdeɛ a wɔnam nkɔmhyɛ ne mpanimfoɔ nsa a wɔde guu wo soɔ no so de maa woɔ no nnna hɔ kwa. Yeinom ho na bɔ mmɔden, yeinom mu na keka wo ho, na wo nkɔsoɔ ada adi ade nyinaa mu. Ma w’ani mmra wo ho ne nkyerɛkyerɛ no so na tena mu, ɛfiri sɛ woyɛ saa a, wobɛgye wo ho ne w’atiefoɔ nkwa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
